title: Canonical transitivity exact sequence of differential sheaves
statement:
Let $h:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the relative Kähler differential sheaves with their universal derivations [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. The canonical map $d_{h/S}:h^*\Omega_{Y/S}\to\Omega_{X/S}$ characterized by $1\otimes da\mapsto d(h^\sharp a)$ [def-a1-relative-differentials-pullback-map] fits into a right exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules
$$h^*\Omega_{Y/S}\xrightarrow{d_{h/S}}\Omega_{X/S}\longrightarrow\Omega_{X/Y}\longrightarrow0.$$
For affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq X$, $\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq Y$, $\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ through which the maps restrict, this is the sequence associated to
$$A\otimes_B\Omega_{B/R}\longrightarrow\Omega_{A/R}\longrightarrow\Omega_{A/B}\longrightarrow0,$$
whose first map sends $a\otimes db$ to $a\,d(h^\sharp b)$, under the pullback identification $h^*\widetilde{\Omega_{B/R}}\cong\widetilde{A\otimes_B\Omega_{B/R}}$ sending the pulled-back section $db$ to $1\otimes db$. These identifications agree under principal localization; the sequence is exact on every stalk and remains the same canonical exact sequence on every source open subscheme. No smoothness, flatness or finite-presentation hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01UX, lemma-triangle-differentials; canonical first map from Tag 01UV, lemma-functoriality-differentials

proof.text: Use the h-relative universal derivation into Ω_{X/Y} as an h≫g-relative derivation: an image h♯(g♯a) is killed because every image of h♯ is killed. Apply relativeDifferentialsHomEquiv to construct q:Ω_{X/S}→Ω_{X/Y}. Its evaluation lemma proves q(da)=da on every source open.

The composite of the canonical first arrow with q is zero. Apply the tensor pullback adjunction and then the universal-property Hom equivalence for Ω_{Y/S}; both are injective. The normalized adjunction unit evaluates on db as the actual pulled-back db. The first arrow sends this to d(h♯b), q sends it to the same h-relative differential, and that differential is zero. This proves the composite is zero as a sheaf morphism.

Apply the normalized affine/stalk comparison theorem to q and its section formula. It gives every specified affine comparison and exactness on every module stalk. Clause (5) of module_stalk_exact then proves middle sheaf exactness, using ModuleCat.shortComplex_exact. For Epi q, any two maps from Ω_{X/Y} that agree after q agree on every da by q(da)=da; injectivity of relativeDifferentialsHomEquiv makes them equal.

For a source open j:O→X the normalized open-comparison theorem supplies e,q_O, both commuting squares, and q_O(da)=da. Let c be the differential congruence for (j≫h)≫g=j≫(h≫g). The map c.hom≫q_O again sends da to da (proved by equality induction for c). Apply the affine/stalk theorem and steps 2–3 to j≫h,g and this map. The two short complexes are isomorphic via identity maps in degrees one and three and c in degree two. ShortComplex.exact_and_epi_g_iff_of_iso transports exactness and the epimorphism to q_O. This gives the full source-open clause.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01UX, 01UV, 01UT and 01US. D5 constructs q directly by the universal property, checks its zero composite through the normalized tensor adjunction, and derives sheaf and source-open exactness from two strictly partial affine/stalk and restriction-comparison statements.
